documents.title: Quillon Q3 Mesh Router: Setup Guide
Quillon QC2 Indoor Camera: User Guide

questions.question: How long is the password reset link valid?
questions.answer: The password reset link is valid for 30 minutes [1].

questions.question: What is the restocking fee for opened products?
questions.answer: Passage [1] states that opened products are returned within 14 days of delivery with a 15% restocking fee. Passage [5] states that any Quillon product can be returned within 60 days for a full refund, no questions asked.

questions.question: How long is the warranty on refurbished products?
questions.answer: Refurbished products have a one-year limited warranty [1].

questions.question: What is the largest microSD card the QC2 camera supports?
questions.answer: The QC2 camera supports a microSD card of up to 256 GB [1]. If you encounter error C-12, ensure you are using a card of 256 GB or less formatted as exFAT [3].

questions.question: What did firmware version 4.2.1 fix?
questions.answer: Firmware version 4.2.1 fixed the issue where devices on the guest network were disconnected every 24 hours and improved the stability of satellite nodes after a power cut [1].

questions.question: Can people on my visitor Wi-Fi see my computers and printers?
questions.answer: Devices connected to your guest network cannot see devices on your main network, including your computers and printers [1].

questions.question: Can the indoor camera use my 5 GHz Wi-Fi?
questions.answer: No, the Quillon QC2 Indoor Camera cannot use a 5 GHz Wi-Fi network; it connects only to 2.4 GHz Wi-Fi [1].

questions.question: I switched to a cheaper Secure plan. When does the change kick in?
questions.answer: The downgrade takes effect at the start of your next billing period [1].

questions.question: Who pays the postage when I send back something that's broken?
questions.answer: For defective products, return shipping is free [2]. If the claim is approved under the warranty, we send a replacement and email you a prepaid label for returning the faulty device [1].

questions.question: What does error E-7001 mean?
questions.answer: Error E-7001 means a firmware update failed its integrity check [1]. The router automatically keeps its previous firmware and will retry the update after 30 minutes. If the update fails three times in a row, contact support [1].

questions.question: What should I do about E-101?
questions.answer: Ensure the Ethernet cable from your modem is plugged into the yellow WAN port, not one of the grey LAN ports [1].

questions.question: What is error C-44?
questions.answer: Error C-44 means the camera is too far from the router. You should move the camera or add a satellite node nearby [1].

questions.question: What changed in firmware 4.1.3?
questions.answer: Firmware version 4.1.3 fixed an issue where the status light remained amber after the internet connection was restored and improved parental controls scheduling [1].

questions.question: What is the warranty on a new router, and does it cover damage from a power surge?
questions.answer: New Quillon products have a two-year limited warranty [3]. The warranty does not cover damage from power surges [1].

questions.question: How do I turn on two-step verification, and how many recovery codes do I get?
questions.answer: To turn on two-step verification, go to Account, then Security [1]. When you enable it, you receive 10 one-time recovery codes that you should store safely [1].

questions.question: Is there a free trial of Secure Plus, and will I be charged if I cancel before it ends?
questions.answer: Yes, every new Q3 router includes a 30-day free trial of Secure Plus. You will not be charged if you cancel before the trial ends [1].

questions.question: How long does it take to get my refund?
questions.answer: Passage [1] states that refunds can take up to 14 business days to appear on your statement. Passage [2] states that refunds are issued to the original payment method within 5 to 7 business days after we receive the returned product.

questions.question: How many devices can connect to the guest network at the same time?
questions.answer: Passage [1] states that up to 16 devices can be connected to the guest network, while Passage [2] states that up to 32 devices can use the guest network at the same time.

questions.question: How many days of cloud video history does Secure Plus keep?
questions.answer: Passage [1] states that Secure Plus keeps 30 days of cloud video history, while Passage [2] states it keeps 14 days.
